blocks.text: Who signs an inspection? The inspector, a supervisor, both?
How long until an auditor needs the report?
Which system do the inspections end up in, and who looks at them there?
Would they want Montague's routing data? (expect: no)
If I only learn three things
2. What an auditor needs, and by when.
3. Where inspections have to end up.
Everything else is a bonus. Listen more than I talk. Before we hang up, play his asks back to him in his words, and confirm Friday at 2 with him.
